name: mockingbird
description: Frontend design that survives the project — brainstorm, artboards, machine-readable manifest, carried through spec, plan and every task brief, then verified against what was built.

plugins.name: mockingbird
plugins.description: Works out a UI design with you, writes HTML artboards plus a machine-readable manifest to docs/design/, carries that design through spec, plan and every task brief so agentic implementation cannot drift away from it, and verifies the built result against the mockup — including whether a control labelled "Abteilung" is actually wired to departments.
